1.word_for_word: त्र्य्-अशीतितम एवं च स्त्रीणां कृष्ण-कथोत्सवे । — The eighty-third and so on, the women celebrated the story of Lord Kṛṣṇa.; द्रौपद्यै कृष्ण-भार्याभिर् उक्ताः स्व-स्व-कर-ग्रहाः ॥ — The wives of Lord Kṛṣṇa told Draupadī about the planets in their respective hands.; अव्ययं कुशलम् ॥१॥ — The infinitive is good.
1.translation: The eighty-third and so on, the women celebrated the story of Lord Kṛṣṇa. The wives of Lord Kṛṣṇa told Draupadī about the planets in their respective hands. The infinitive is good.

2.word_for_word: तत् पादेक्षया हतम् अंहो येषां ते ॥२॥ — Oh, those who have killed that with the sight of their feet.
2.translation: Oh, those who have killed that with the sight of their feet.

3.word_for_word: महतां मनस् तः सकाशान् मुख-द्वारतो निःसृतं क्वचित् कदाचिद् देहं भृतां देह-धारिणां देह-कृच् चासाव् अस्मृतिश् चाविद्या तां छिनत्तीति तथा तम् । — Sometimes the body of the great minds, which sometimes comes out of the mouth through the door of the body, is cut off by the body-crushing, forgetfulness and ignorance of the body-bearers.; देह-कृद् ईश्वरस् तद् विषयाज्ञान-च्छिदं वा ॥३॥ — The Lord is the creator of the body, or that which breaks the ignorance of objects.
3.translation: Sometimes the body of the great minds, which sometimes comes out of the mouth through the door of the body, is cut off by the body-crushing, forgetfulness and ignorance of the body-bearers. The Lord is the creator of the body, or that which breaks the ignorance of objects.

4.word_for_word: हि त्वेति पद-द्वयम् । — For you are two terms.; त्वा त्वां हि एव त्वाम् एव नताः स्मेत्य् अर्थः । — It means that we are bowing down to You, to You, to You alone.; कथं-भूतं ? — How-ever it happened?; आत्म-धाम्ना स्वरूप-प्रकाशेन विधुता निरस्ता आत्म-कृता बुद्धि-निमित्तास् तिस्रोऽवस्था यस्मिंस् तम् । — The three states in which the intelligence caused by the Self is rejected and rejected by the light of the Self-realization.; अत एवानन्द-संप्लवं सर्वानन्द-कदम्ब-रूपम् । — That is why the flood of bliss is the form of the kadamba of all bliss.; अखण्डं चापरिच्छिन्नम् । — It is unbroken and unbroken.; यतो न कुण्ठः कुण्ठितो बोधश् चिच्-छक्तिर् यस्य तम् । — Because he is not frustrated, he is not frustrated, and he has the power of chich.; नन्व् एवं-रूपता श्री-कृष्णस्य कुतः ? — Where, then, does Sri Krishna have such a form?; अस्मद्-आदिवत् प्रतीतेः । — of perception as in ours and so on.; अत आहुः---कालोपसृष्टेति । — Therefore they say that it is time-consuming.; कालेनोपसृष्टा विप्लुताश् च ते निगमाश् च तेषाम् अवने रक्षार्थम् आत्ता उपात्ता योग-मायया आकृतिर् नराकार-मूर्तिर् येन तम् । — They were swept away by time and flooded, and to protect them in the forest, the figure of the human form of the Lord was taken up by the illusory energy of yoga.; परमहंसानां गतिं त्वाम् । — You are the path of the Paramahansas.; अतस् तवैवं-रूपत्वाद् अस्माकं च त्वन्-माययैतत् सर्व-वैपरीत्यात् त्वाम् एव नताः स्मेति । — Therefore, because You are such a form and because of Your illusory power, and because this is all the opposite, we bow down to You alone.; यद् वा, त्वाम् इति प्रकरणाज् ज्ञातव्यम् । — Whatever it is, you should know from the case.; त्वां नताः स्म । — We bowed down to you.; किं कृत्वा ? — What's the difference?; हित्वा । — Hitva.; किं ? — What is it?; आत्म-धाम आत्मा शरीरं धाम गृहं तच् च तच् च । — The self-dwelling place is the soul, the body is the dwelling place, the house is that and that is it.; देह-दैहिक-सङ्गं परित्यज्येत्य् अर्थः । — This means that one should abandon attachment to the body and the physical body.; समानम् अन्यत् ॥४॥ — The same is true of another.; : भौमाहृत-शताधिक-षोडश-सहस्र-स्त्रीषु मुख्या। — Chief among the hundred and sixteen thousand women taken from the earth.
4.translation: For you are two terms. It means that we are bowing down to You, to You, to You alone. How-ever it happened? The three states in which the intelligence caused by the Self is rejected and rejected by the light of the Self-realization. That is why the flood of bliss is the form of the kadamba of all bliss. It is unbroken and unbroken. Because he is not frustrated, he is not frustrated, and he has the power of chich. Where, then, does Sri Krishna have such a form? of perception as in ours and so on. Therefore they say that it is time-consuming. They were swept away by time and flooded, and to protect them in the forest, the figure of the human form of the Lord was taken up by the illusory energy of yoga. You are the path of the Paramahansas. Therefore, because You are such a form and because of Your illusory power, and because this is all the opposite, we bow down to You alone. Whatever it is, you should know from the case. We bowed down to you. What's the difference? Hitva. What is it? The self-dwelling place is the soul, the body is the dwelling place, the house is that and that is it. This means that one should abandon attachment to the body and the physical body. The same is true of another. Chief among the hundred and sixteen thousand women taken from the earth.

5.word_for_word: त्रिषु लोकेषु गीताः ॥५॥ — They are sung in the three worlds.
5.translation: They are sung in the three worlds.

6.word_for_word: कौशले ! — Skills!; हे सत्ये ! — O truths!; शैब्ये ! — Shaibye!; हे मित्रविन्दे ! — O Mitravinde!; रोहिणी-नाम काचित् पट्ट-महिषी-तुल्या ॥६॥ — There was a woman named Rohini who was like a queen of the pattas.
6.translation: Skills! O truths! Shaibye! O Mitravinde! There was a woman named Rohini who was like a queen of the pattas.

7.word_for_word: अन्याः श्री-कृष्णस्य पत्न्यः ॥७॥ — Others are the wives of Sri Krishna.
7.translation: Others are the wives of Sri Krishna.

8.word_for_word: मा माम् अर्पयितुं संपादयितुं राजसु जरासन्धादिषूद्यत-कार्मुकेषु सत्स्व् अजेया ये भटास् तेषां शेखरिता मुकुट-वत् कृता अङ्घ्रि-रेणवो येन । — Do not offer me to accomplish the dust of the feet of the invincible soldiers who were invincible when kings like Jarāsandha and others raised their bows.; तेषां मूर्ध्नि पदं दधद् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that he placed his foot on their heads.; तस्य श्री-निकेतस्य चरणो ममार्चनायास्तु ॥८॥ — May the feet of that abode of the goddess of fortune be for my worship.
8.translation: Do not offer me to accomplish the dust of the feet of the invincible soldiers who were invincible when kings like Jarāsandha and others raised their bows. This means that he placed his foot on their heads. May the feet of that abode of the goddess of fortune be for my worship.

9.word_for_word: सनाभेर् भ्रातुर् वधेन सिंह-कृतेन तप्तं हृद् यस्य तेन मे ततेन तातेन लिप्तम् अभिशापं दुर्यशोऽपमार्ष्टुं परिहर्तुम् ऋक्षराजं जित्वा रत्नं स्यमन्तकम् उपाजहारानीतवान् । — To erase the curse and disgrace that my father had smeared on me by the killing of his brother Sanabhi, whose heart was burning with the lion’s death, he defeated the king of bears and brought him the jewel Syamantak, who was his necklace.; अथानन्तरं मत्-पित्रे रत्नम् अदात्, तेन स्वापराधेन भीतः स मे पिता प्रभवे श्री-कृष्णाय माम् अदिशत ददौ । — Afterwards, he gave the jewel to my father, and my father, afraid of his own offense, instructed me to the Lord, Lord Kṛṣṇa, and gave it to me.; दत्ताम् अक्रूरादिभ्यः प्रतिश्रुताम् अपीत्य् अर्थः ॥९॥ — This means that it was given and promised to Akrura and others.
9.translation: To erase the curse and disgrace that my father had smeared on me by the killing of his brother Sanabhi, whose heart was burning with the lion’s death, he defeated the king of bears and brought him the jewel Syamantak, who was his necklace. Afterwards, he gave the jewel to my father, and my father, afraid of his own offense, instructed me to the Lord, Lord Kṛṣṇa, and gave it to me. This means that it was given and promised to Akrura and others.

10.word_for_word: देह-कृत् पिता अमुं श्री-कृष्णं निज-नाथं स्वामिनं देवम् ईश्वरं सीता-पतिं प्राज्ञायाविज्ञाय त्रिणवहानि त्रि-नवाहानि, ह्रस्वश् छन्दोऽनुरोधेन । — The father, who created the body, understood this Śrī Kṛṣṇa, his master, his master, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the husband of Sītā, to be wise, and he gave him three days, three nine days, and a short verse at his request.; सप्त-विंशति-दिनान्य् अमुनाभ्ययुध्यत् । — He fought with him for twenty-seven days.; परीक्षितः सञ्जाता परीक्षा यस्य स परीक्षितस् तं साक्षात् सीता-पतिर् एवासाव् इति ज्ञात्वा पादौ प्रगृह्य मणिना सह माम् अर्हणम् उपाहरद् अर्हणतया समर्पितवान् । — Parikshit, who had been tested, knew that Parikshit was the husband of Sita himself, and he took hold of his feet and presented me with the jewel as an offering.; अहो तर्हि त्वम् अति-श्रेष्ठासि, नेत्य् आह---अमुष्याहं दासीति ॥१०॥ — Oh, then you are the very best, no, he said, and I am his maidservant.; : अष्टम-विंशाहम् इति तु समाप्ति-दिनं गृहीत्वा। — Twenty-eighth, however, taking the date of completion.
10.translation: The father, who created the body, understood this Śrī Kṛṣṇa, his master, his master, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the husband of Sītā, to be wise, and he gave him three days, three nine days, and a short verse at his request. He fought with him for twenty-seven days. Parikshit, who had been tested, knew that Parikshit was the husband of Sita himself, and he took hold of his feet and presented me with the jewel as an offering. Oh, then you are the very best, no, he said, and I am his maidservant. Twenty-eighth, however, taking the date of completion.

11.word_for_word: सख्या अर्जुनेन । — Sakhya Arjuna.; तस्य गृह-मार्जनी गृह-संमार्जन-कर्त्री ॥११॥ — His housewife is the one who cleans the house.
11.translation: Sakhya Arjuna. His housewife is the one who cleans the house.

12.word_for_word: शुनां यूथ-गतं स्व-बलिं द्विपारिः सिंह इवेति । — A herd of dogs is like a lion that has its own sacrifice.; मे भ्रातुश् चापकुरुतोऽपकारं कुर्वतो विजित्य । — Having conquered my brother’s bow, he was doing me harm.; श्रियौको लक्ष्मी-निवासः । — Shriyauko is the abode of Lakshmi.; तस्याङ्घ्र्य्-अवनेजनत्वं चरण-क्षालन-कर्तृत्वम् अनुभवं प्रति जन्म मेऽस्तु ॥१२॥ — May I be born to experience the washing of His feet and the washing of His feet.
12.translation: A herd of dogs is like a lion that has its own sacrifice. Having conquered my brother’s bow, he was doing me harm. Shriyauko is the abode of Lakshmi. May I be born to experience the washing of His feet and the washing of His feet.

13.word_for_word: सप्तोक्ष्णो वृषभान् । — The seven-eyed bulls.; बलं च वीर्यं च सुतीक्ष्ण-शृङ्गाणि चाति-शयितानि येषां तान् मे पित्रा कृतान् संपादितान् बलीयसे मां दातुं क्षिति-पानां वीर्यस्य बलस्य परीक्षणाय तान् अति-प्रसिद्धान् वीराणां दुर्मदं घ्नन्ति ये तांस् तरसा शीघ्रम् एव निगृह्य दमयित्वा क्रीडन्न् अनायासेनैव बबन्ध । — You are strong enough to give me the strength and courage that my father had acquired with sharp horns and very lying down.; अज-तोकान् अजापत्यानि ॥१३॥ — Aja-tokas and Ajapatyas.
13.translation: The seven-eyed bulls. You are strong enough to give me the strength and courage that my father had acquired with sharp horns and very lying down. Aja-tokas and Ajapatyas.

14.word_for_word: वीर्यम् एव शुल्कं देयं यस्यास् ताम् । — She whose semen is the only fee to be paid.; दासीभिः सह चतुर्-अङ्गिणीं गजाश्वादि-सेना-युक्तां पुरं निन्ये ॥१४॥ — Along with his maidservants he led a four-legged army of elephants and horses to the city.
14.translation: She whose semen is the only fee to be paid. Along with his maidservants he led a four-legged army of elephants and horses to the city.

15.word_for_word: हे कृष्णे हे द्रौपदि । — O Krishna, O Draupadi!; तस्मिन्न् एव चित्तं यस्यास् तां माम् अक्षौहिण्या सेनया सह । — She’s got me with her army of Akshauhini, whose mind is on that very thing.; सखी-जनैश् च सह ॥१५॥ — and with her friends and people.
15.translation: O Krishna, O Draupadi! She’s got me with her army of Akshauhini, whose mind is on that very thing. and with her friends and people.

16.word_for_word: येन पाद-संस्पर्शेनात्मनो मे तत् कैवल्याख्यं श्रेयो भवेत् सः । — By the touch of My feet, that self-realization called Kaivalya is attained.; यद् वा, येन कारणेनात्मनो जीवस्य तच् छ्रेयः स एव पुरुषार्थ इति ॥१६॥ — Whatever, for whatever reason, is the best for the living entity, that is the purpose of man.
16.translation: By the touch of My feet, that self-realization called Kaivalya is attained. Whatever, for whatever reason, is the best for the living entity, that is the purpose of man.

17.word_for_word: राज्ञि ! — Queen!; हे द्रौपदि ! — O Draupadi!; यथा मित्रविन्दायास् तथैव ममापि चित्तं मुकुन्द-विषयम् आसीत् । — Like Mitravindha, my mind was fixed on Mukunda.; सुसंमृश्य सु-विचार्य पद्म-हस्तया श्रिया वृतः किल, अतोऽपि मम चित्तं श्री-मुकुन्दे आसेति ॥१७॥ — After careful consideration and careful consideration, I am indeed surrounded by the lotus-hand of the goddess of fortune, and therefore my mind is fixed on the goddess of fortune, Mukunda.
17.translation: Queen! O Draupadi! Like Mitravindha, my mind was fixed on Mukunda. After careful consideration and careful consideration, I am indeed surrounded by the lotus-hand of the goddess of fortune, and therefore my mind is fixed on the goddess of fortune, Mukunda.

18.word_for_word: तत्र श्री-कृष्ण-प्राप्ताव् उपायम् अचीकरत् कारयाम् आस ॥१८॥ — There, when Sri Krishna reached him, he made a remedy and was in the process of doing it.
18.translation: There, when Sri Krishna reached him, he made a remedy and was in the process of doing it.

19-20.word_for_word: यथा राज्ञि तव स्वयंवरे पार्थस्येप्सया आप्तुम् इच्छया कृतस् तथा मत्स्यं कारितवान् । — Just as he did at your swayamvara, O queen, to obtain the desire of Arjuna, so he made the fish.; पाठान्तरे पार्थस्येषुणापाकृतः । — In another text, he was shot by Partha’s arrow.; तर्हीमम् अप्य् अर्जुन एव किं नाविध्यत् तत्राह---अयं त्व् इति । — Then why didn’t Arjuna himself shoot him?; स मत्स्यो बहिर् एवाच्छन्नो नान्तरतः स्तम्भ-लग्नयोर् ध्व-दृष्ट्या संल्लक्ष्यते, अयं तु न तथा, किन्तु स्तम्भ-मूले निहित-कलश-जले केवलं दृश्यतेऽतो दृष्टिर् अधस्ताद् उपरि च लक्ष्यम् इति श्री-कृष्ण-व्यतिरेकेण न कस्यापि भेद्य इति भावः ॥१९-२०॥ — That fish is covered only on the outside and is not perceived by the sight of the pillars from the inside, but this is not so, but it is only visible in the water of the pitcher at the base of the pillar, therefore the sight is aimed from below and above.
19-20.translation: Just as he did at your swayamvara, O queen, to obtain the desire of Arjuna, so he made the fish. In another text, he was shot by Partha’s arrow. Then why didn’t Arjuna himself shoot him? That fish is covered only on the outside and is not perceived by the sight of the pillars from the inside, but this is not so, but it is only visible in the water of the pitcher at the base of the pillar, therefore the sight is aimed from below and above.

21.word_for_word: मत्स्यं वेद्धुम् । — To know the fish.; पर्षदि संसदि । — in the council in the parliament.; मद्-धियो मय्य् एव धीर् येषाम् इति अन्य-चित्ता न वेद्धुं शक्ता इति भवः ॥२१॥ — This means that those whose minds are fixed on Me alone cannot know that other minds are in Me.
21.translation: To know the fish. in the council in the parliament. This means that those whose minds are fixed on Me alone cannot know that other minds are in Me.

22.word_for_word: तद् एवाह---आदायेति । — That is what he said, to take.; अमुना चापेन ॥२२॥ — with this bow.
22.translation: That is what he said, to take. with this bow.

23.word_for_word: नाविन्दंस् तद्-अवस्थितिम् इति मागधादीनां क्रिया-शक्तिर् एव न तु लक्ष्याभिज्ञतेत्य् अर्थः ॥२३॥ — This means that the Magadhas and others did not find that position but only the power of action and not the knowledge of the objective.
23.translation: This means that the Magadhas and others did not find that position but only the power of action and not the knowledge of the objective.

24-25.word_for_word: यत्तो यत्नवान् । — Yatto tried to do it.; असृजन् मुमोच । — He released the creator.; स बाणो मत्स्यं नाच्छिनत्, परं केवलं पस्पर्श । — The arrow did not cut the fish, but only touched it.; ज्ञानवान् अप्य् अर्जुनो बलेनापूर्ण इत्य् अर्थः ॥२४-२५॥ — This means that even the wise Arjuna is full of strength (24-25).
24-25.translation: Yatto tried to do it. He released the creator. The arrow did not cut the fish, but only touched it. This means that even the wise Arjuna is full of strength (24-25).

26-27.word_for_word: अभिजिति सर्वार्थ-साधके मुहूर्ते ॥२६-२७॥ — Abhijit is the moment that accomplishes all purposes.26-2
26-27.translation: Abhijit is the moment that accomplishes all purposes.26-2

28.word_for_word: भगवत्-प्राप्ति-हर्ष-निर्भरेणात्मानम् एवानुवर्णयन्त्य् आह द्वाभ्याम्---तद् रङ्गम् इति । — Describing himself as full of the joy of attaining the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he argues in two ways: “That is the colour.”; तत् तदा कलौ कल-स्वनौ नूपुरौ ययोस् ताभ्यां पद्भ्यां रङ्गं प्राविशम् । — That’s when I entered the arena with my feet, which were wearing two anklets that sounded like a pitcher.; कनकेनोज्ज्वलां रत्न-मालाम् । — A necklace of gems glittering with gold.; निवीय प्रावृत्य परिधाय च नीवीबन्धेन च । — She covered herself with a skirt and dressed herself with a skirt tie.; कौशिकाग्र्ये उत्तम-कौशेय-वस्त्रे । — She wore a fine silk dress on the tip of the Kaushika.; स-व्रीडो हासो यस्मिंस् तद् वदनं यस्याः सा । — She whose face is in which she has a shy smile.; कबर्यां धृताः स्रजो यया सा ॥२८॥ — She who carried the garlands in the grave
28.translation: Describing himself as full of the joy of attaining the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he argues in two ways: “That is the colour.” That’s when I entered the arena with my feet, which were wearing two anklets that sounded like a pitcher. A necklace of gems glittering with gold. She covered herself with a skirt and dressed herself with a skirt tie. She wore a fine silk dress on the tip of the Kaushika. She whose face is in which she has a shy smile. She who carried the garlands in the grave

29.word_for_word: उरवः कुन्तला यस्मिन्, कुण्डलयोस् त्विषो ययोस् ते गण्ड-स्थले यस्मिंस् तच् च तच् च । — The thighs are the earrings in which the earrings are, and the earrings are the earrings in which the cheeks are.; शिशिरः सन्तापहरो हासो येषु तैः कटाक्ष-मोक्षैर् अपाङ्ग-मोक्षण-विलासैः । — Winter is the relief of sorrow, and laughter is the pleasure of releasing the disabled with their glances.; अनुरक्तं हृदयं यस्याः साहम् ॥२९॥ — I am the one whose heart is attached to her.
29.translation: The thighs are the earrings in which the earrings are, and the earrings are the earrings in which the cheeks are. Winter is the relief of sorrow, and laughter is the pleasure of releasing the disabled with their glances. I am the one whose heart is attached to her.

31.word_for_word: याज्ञसेनि ! — Yagnaseni!; हे द्रौपदि ! — O Draupadi!; ईशे श्री-कृष्णे ! — Ishe Sri-Krishna!; मया वृते सति स्पर्धन्तः स्पर्धमानाः । — When I chose them, they competed and competed.; नन्व् एवं परमैश्वर्यं दृष्टवतां कुतः स्पर्धावसरः ? — Where, then, is the opportunity for competition for those who have thus seen the supreme wealth?; तत्राह---हृच्-छयातुरा इति । — There he says, Hrich-shayatura.; हृच्-छयेन कामेनातुरा विवशाः । — They were overwhelmed by the shadow of their hearts and lust.; काम-विजृम्भिता स्पर्धेति भावः ॥३१॥ — This means that competition is expanded by lust.
31.translation: Yagnaseni! O Draupadi! Ishe Sri-Krishna! When I chose them, they competed and competed. Where, then, is the opportunity for competition for those who have thus seen the supreme wealth? There he says, Hrich-shayatura. They were overwhelmed by the shadow of their hearts and lust. This means that competition is expanded by lust.

32.word_for_word: हय-रत्नानां चतुष्टयं यस्मिंस् तं रथम् । — The chariot in which he had four horses and jewels.; द्वाभ्यां मामालिङ्ग्य द्वभ्यां धनुर्-बाणौ गृहीत्वा चतुर्-भुजस् तस्थौ ॥३२॥ — He embraced me with both hands and stood there holding both bows and arrows.
32.translation: The chariot in which he had four horses and jewels. He embraced me with both hands and stood there holding both bows and arrows.

33.word_for_word: मृगाणां मिषतां मृग-राड् इव । — He looked like a deer king when the deer looked at him.; तदा हरिर् जगामेति शेषो ज्ञातव्यः । — Then the Lord Hari left, and the rest is to be understood.; दारुकस्यैव वा मृग-राजोपमा ॥३३॥ — Or like the king of deer of Daruka himself.
33.translation: He looked like a deer king when the deer looked at him. Then the Lord Hari left, and the rest is to be understood. Or like the king of deer of Daruka himself.

34.word_for_word: अन्वसज्जन्त पृष्ठतः सक्ता बभूवुः । — They followed him and became attached to him from behind.; निषेद्धुं प्रतिबन्धं कर्तुं केचन पुरतो गत्वा पथि संयत्ता बभूवुर् इत्य् अर्थः । — This meant that some of them went ahead and stood ready on the road to forbid and restrict them; उद्धृतेष्व्-आसा ऊर्ध्व-कृत-चापाः । — They raised their hopes and raised their bows.; ग्राम-सिंहाः श्वानो हरिं सिंहं यथेति ॥३४॥ — The village lions are like dogs to the lion Hari.
34.translation: They followed him and became attached to him from behind. This meant that some of them went ahead and stood ready on the road to forbid and restrict them They raised their hopes and raised their bows. The village lions are like dogs to the lion Hari.

36.word_for_word: रविं छादयन्ति ते रवि-च्छदा ध्वजेषु पटा यस्यां, चित्राणि तोरणानि यस्यां, सा च सा च । — They cover the sun with sunshades on their flags; तां कुश-स्थलीं पुरीं यदु-पतिः समाविशत् । — The lord of the Yadus entered that city of Kuśa-sthalī.; स्व-केतनं मण्डल-मस्त-शलं वा ॥३६॥ — or his own dwelling, or a circle-headed shack.
36.translation: They cover the sun with sunshades on their flags The lord of the Yadus entered that city of Kuśa-sthalī. or his own dwelling, or a circle-headed shack.

37.word_for_word: महार्ह-वासः-प्रभृतिभिः सुहृदादीन् पूजयाम् आस ॥३७॥ — He worshiped his friends and others with expensive clothes and so on.
37.translation: He worshiped his friends and others with expensive clothes and so on.

38.word_for_word: दास्यादिभिः सहायुधानि पूर्णायापि ददौ ॥३८॥ — He also gave weapons to Purna along with maidservants and others
38.translation: He also gave weapons to Purna along with maidservants and others

39.word_for_word: इमा अष्टौ वयं सर्व-सङ्ग-निवृत्त्या तपसा स्व-धर्मेणाद्धा साक्षात् तस्य गृह-दासिका बभूविम ॥३९॥ — These eight of us, having renounced all attachments, by austerities and by our own duty, became directly his housemaids.
39.translation: These eight of us, having renounced all attachments, by austerities and by our own duty, became directly his housemaids.

40.word_for_word: क्षितिजये दिग्-विजये जितानां राज्ञां कन्या नोऽस्मांस् तेन रुद्धा ज्ञात्वा ततो निर्मुच्य संसृतेर् विमोक्षो यस्मात् तत्-पादाम्बुजम् अनुस्मरन्तीर् नः परिणायोदवहत् । — The daughters of kings who had conquered the earth and the directions knew that we were trapped by Him, and then He released us and brought us to His marriage, remembering His lotus feet, from which we are liberated from material existence.; आप्त-कामोऽपि यः ॥४०॥ — Even if he is satisfied with his desires.
40.translation: The daughters of kings who had conquered the earth and the directions knew that we were trapped by Him, and then He released us and brought us to His marriage, remembering His lotus feet, from which we are liberated from material existence. Even if he is satisfied with his desires.

41-43.word_for_word: न वयम् इति । — Not that we are.; साम्राज्यादि न कामयामहे, किन्तु एतस्य श्रीमत्-पाद-रजो मूर्ध्ना वोढुं कामयामह इति । — We do not desire empire and other things, but we desire to carry the dust of His beautiful feet on our heads.; ननु तस्य गृहिण्यो यूयं सर्व-सम्पद्-भाजः । — Indeed, you are his wives and share all his wealth.; किम् एवं कामयध्वं ? — Do you wish it so?; अत आह---हे साध्वि! — Therefore he said, O saint!; साम्राज्यं सार्वभौम-पदम् । — Empire is a sovereign position.; स्वाराज्यम् ऐन्द्रं पदम् । — Swarajya is the position of Indra.; भौज्यं तद्-उभय-भोग-भाक्त्वम् । — Bhaujya is the enjoyment of both.; विविधं राजत इति विराट्, तस्य भावो वैराज्यम्, अणिमादि-सिद्धि-भाक्त्वम् इत्य् अर्थः । — Virat, who shines in various ways, means that his being is Vairajya, and that he is a devotee of the perfections of Anima and others.; पारमेष्ठ्यं ब्रह्म-पदम् । — The supreme position is the Brahman.; आनन्त्यं मोक्षम् । — Infinite liberation.; हरेः पदं तत्-सालोक्यादि । — The position of the Lord is that-salokya and so on.; न तु कामयामहे इति । — It is not that we desire it.; यद् वा, बह्व्-ऋच-ब्राह्मणोक्त-क्रमेण प्राग्-आदि-दिक्-चतुष्टयाधिपत्यानि साम्राज्य-भौज्य-स्वाराज्य-वैराज्यानि व्याख्येयानि ॥४१॥ — Or else, in the order described in the Bahv-Rich-Brahmana, the four kingdoms of the east, the beginning and the end, the empire, the food, the self-government and the kingdom, should be explained.; तत् किं तत्-पद-रज एव काम्यते ? — Is that the dust of that foot that is desired?; अत आहुः---श्रियः कुच-कुङ्कुम-गन्धाढ्यम् इति ब्रह्मादि-सेव्यया लक्ष्म्यापि सेवितत्वाद् इति भावः ॥४२॥ — Therefore they say that the breasts of the goddess of fortune are rich in fragrance of saffron, since even Lakshmi, who is worshiped by Brahma and others, is worshipped.; ननु तर्ह्य् अतिदुर्लभत्वात् किं तद्-वाञ्छया ? — Indeed, since it is very rare, what is the desire for it?; अत आहुः---व्रज-स्त्रिय इति । — Therefore they say, Vraja-striya.; यद् यथा । — That’s like.; गावो गाः । — Cows are cows.; महात्मनोऽपि गाश् चारयतः । — Even the great man was grazing his cows.; पाद-स्पर्शं च गोपा यथा वाञ्छन्ति, तद्वत् । — The touch of the feet is just as the cowherd men desire.; तत्-पराणां सुलभ इति भावः ॥४३॥ — That is, it is easy for others.
41-43.translation: Not that we are. We do not desire empire and other things, but we desire to carry the dust of His beautiful feet on our heads. Indeed, you are his wives and share all his wealth. Do you wish it so? Therefore he said, O saint! Empire is a sovereign position. Swarajya is the position of Indra. Bhaujya is the enjoyment of both. Virat, who shines in various ways, means that his being is Vairajya, and that he is a devotee of the perfections of Anima and others. The supreme position is the Brahman. Infinite liberation. The position of the Lord is that-salokya and so on. It is not that we desire it. Or else, in the order described in the Bahv-Rich-Brahmana, the four kingdoms of the east, the beginning and the end, the empire, the food, the self-government and the kingdom, should be explained. Is that the dust of that foot that is desired? Therefore they say that the breasts of the goddess of fortune are rich in fragrance of saffron, since even Lakshmi, who is worshiped by Brahma and others, is worshipped. Indeed, since it is very rare, what is the desire for it? Therefore they say, Vraja-striya. That’s like. Cows are cows. Even the great man was grazing his cows. The touch of the feet is just as the cowherd men desire. That is, it is easy for others.
